title: Karbala Yaad Bohat Aati Hai
body:
Salam Aqaa Salam Aqaa
Kareem e Karb o Bala Mojza Dekha Deyjay
Karbala Yaad Bohat Aati Hai Bula Leyjay
1) Hussain Aap Jo Chahain To Kuch Nahe Mushkil
Tarap Raha Hai Bohat Karbala Ki Yaad Main Dil Phir Ake Bar Mujhy Karbala Dekha Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
2)  Tmhary Rozay Py Anay Main Aje Diqqat Hai Magar Khabar Hai Tmhain Mujh Ko Kitne Chahat Hai
Main Sir Kay Bal Chala Aoga Bus Sada Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mere Khayal Main Jab Aye Do Katty Bazo
Alam Ko Dekh Kay Ankho Main Agaye Ansoo
Tarap Raha Hoon Alamdar Say Mila Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Gulo e Asghar e Beshair Chidh Gaya Tha Jidhar
Sabeel Doodh Ki Ja Kar Lagao Main Bhe Udhar
Main Zair'on Say Kahon Ga Mujhy Dua Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Kise Bhe Hal Main Jana Hai Roz e Ashura
Laho Badan Say Bahana Hai Roz e Ashura
Hai Matmi Ki Sada Phir Hamain Sada Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Bulain Ap Jisay Chahain Apnay Rozay Per
Ghulam Apki Taqseem Py Hai Razi Magar
Sukoon Dil Ko Milay Kis Tarha Bata Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Hain Ashk Ankhon Main Aur Dil Udas Hai Mera
Mujhy Bulain Gay Kb Aap Karbala Moula
Kuch Akay Khuwab Main He Mujh Ko Asra Deyjay
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Sada Rehan e Aza Ki Hai Bar Zuban e Raza
Main Arbaeen Py Mishi Karo Ga Aye Moula Phir Ake Bar Mujhy Paon Per Chala Deyjay
